gateway_label: an LLM gateway with MCP features
install: pip litellm[proxy]==1.109.1 in its own venv (open-source build, no licence key, no database)

login_server.scope_cap: requested ∩ subject; subject's scope if none requested

client_transport: HTTPTransport (legacy Streamable HTTP); MCPClient asks for 2026-07-28, LiteLLM answers with its default set
upstream_protocol_version: 2025-11-25 (the upstream answers initialize with the requested legacy version; LiteLLM 1.109.1 advertises 2024-11-05..2025-11-25 by default)
caller_auth: x-litellm-api-key: throwaway master key; Authorization: Bearer <user JWT>
gateway_run_config:
# LiteLLM 1.109.1 config for the XID-10 gate. Loopback only; the driver
# (integration/xid10_litellm_gate.py) substitutes http://127.0.0.1:4580/mcp,
# http://127.0.0.1:4564/token, sha256:273f426206c4 and {{STATIC_TOKEN}} into a temp copy.
# The master key comes from the environment (a throwaway generated per run).
model_list: []
litellm_settings:
  telemetry: false
general_settings:
  master_key: os.environ/LITELLM_MASTER_KEY
mcp_servers:
  notes:
    url: http://127.0.0.1:4580/mcp
    transport: http
    auth_type: oauth2_token_exchange
    token_exchange_endpoint: http://127.0.0.1:4564/token
    client_id: litellm-gw
    client_secret: sha256:273f426206c4
    audience: https://upstream.test/mcp
    subject_token_type: urn:ietf:params:oauth:token-type:jwt
    token_exchange_profile: rfc8693
    scopes: ["read:notes"]
label: fails_closed
reason: nothing reached the upstream while the exchange failed; the caller got an error; the control reached it first

exchange_fails_new_token.result: {"content": [{"text": "Error: Missing or invalid subject token. Authenticate with your identity provider and send its token in the Authorization Bearer header. LiteLLM API keys and Admin UI sessions cannot be used for token exchange.", "type": "text"}], "isError": true}

exchange_fails_no_authorization.result: {"content": [{"text": "Error: Missing or invalid subject token. Authenticate with your identity provider and send its token in the Authorization Bearer header. LiteLLM API keys and Admin UI sessions cannot be used for token exchange.", "type": "text"}], "isError": true}

per_server_endpoint_no_token.www_authenticate: Bearer resource_metadata="/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/mcp/notes", error="invalid_token", error_description="Missing or invalid subject token; authenticate with the IdP and retry"
per_server_endpoint_no_token.body: {"detail":"Missing or invalid subject token. Authenticate with your identity provider and send its token in the Authorization Bearer header. LiteLLM API keys and Admin UI sessions cannot be used for token exchange."}

broken_fixture.name: fall-through deputy (forwards with no Authorization when the exchange fails)
broken_fixture.reason: a request made while the exchange failed reached the upstream

caller_error_text: {"content": [{"text": "Error: Missing or invalid subject token. Authenticate with your identity provider and send its token in the Authorization Bearer header. LiteLLM API keys and Admin UI sessions cannot be used for token exchange.", "type": "text"}], "isError": true}
